library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# --- 1. Load differential analysis results ---
deg <- as.data.frame(read_excel("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet 1"))
cat("Loaded:", nrow(deg), "rows\n")

# Some gene IDs are duplicated. Aggregate duplicates by taking the row with the smallest p-value.
deg_clean <- deg %>%
  filter(!is.na(pvalue), !is.na(log2FoldChange), pvalue > 0) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  slice_min(pvalue, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("After dedup & NA drop:", nrow(deg_clean), "genes\n")

# -log10(p); cap Inf so they remain visible but finite
max_finite_neglogp <- max(-log10(deg_clean$pvalue[is.finite(-log10(deg_clean$pvalue))]))
deg_clean$neglogp <- -log10(deg_clean$pvalue)
deg_clean$neglogp[!is.finite(deg_clean$neglogp)] <- max_finite_neglogp
cat("Capped -log10(p) at:", round(max_finite_neglogp, 2), "\n")

# --- 2. Thresholds ---
fc_cut <- 1.0
p_cut  <- 0.05
y_thr  <- -log10(p_cut)   # ~1.301
cat("Thresholds: |log2FC| >", fc_cut, ", p <", p_cut, "  =>  y_thr =", round(y_thr, 3), "\n")

# --- 3. Classification ---
deg_clean <- deg_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Regulation = case_when(
      log2FoldChange >  fc_cut & pvalue < p_cut ~ "Up",
      log2FoldChange < -fc_cut & pvalue < p_cut ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    )
  )

cat("\nSignificance counts:\n")
print(table(deg_clean$Regulation))

# Save processed table for next cell
saveRDS(deg_clean, "deg_clean.rds")

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

deg_clean <- readRDS("deg_clean.rds")

# --- 4. Diagonal cutoff setup ---
fc_cut <- 1.0
p_cut  <- 0.05
y_thr  <- -log10(p_cut)
slope  <- 0.6   # slope of the diagonal threshold lines

# Diagonal lines:
#   Right: y = y_thr + slope * (x - fc_cut),  for x >= fc_cut
#   Left:  y = y_thr + slope * (-x - fc_cut), for x <= -fc_cut
xmax_x <- max(abs(deg_clean$log2FoldChange))
x_seq_r <- seq(fc_cut,  xmax_x * 1.05, length.out = 200)
x_seq_l <- seq(-xmax_x * 1.05, -fc_cut, length.out = 200)
diag_right <- data.frame(x = x_seq_r, y = y_thr + slope * (x_seq_r - fc_cut))
diag_left  <- data.frame(x = x_seq_l, y = y_thr + slope * (-x_seq_l - fc_cut))
ymax_plot <- max(c(deg_clean$neglogp, diag_right$y, diag_left$y)) * 1.05

# --- 5. Top genes for labelling ---
top_up <- deg_clean %>%
  filter(Regulation == "Up") %>%
  arrange(pvalue) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

top_down <- deg_clean %>%
  filter(Regulation == "Down") %>%
  arrange(pvalue) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

cat("Top 5 Up genes:\n");   print(top_up[1:5, c("id","log2FoldChange","pvalue","neglogp")])
cat("\nTop 5 Down genes:\n"); print(top_down[1:5, c("id","log2FoldChange","pvalue","neglogp")])

# --- 6. Build the diagonal volcano plot ---
p <- ggplot(deg_clean, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neglogp)) +
  # Background NS points
  geom_point(data = subset(deg_clean, Regulation == "NS"),
             color = "grey75", size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  # Down-regulated
  geom_point(data = subset(deg_clean, Regulation == "Down"),
             color = "#3B7BB5", size = 1.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  # Up-regulated
  geom_point(data = subset(deg_clean, Regulation == "Up"),
             color = "#D6423A", size = 1.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  # Reference horizontal threshold
  geom_hline(yintercept = y_thr, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cut, fc_cut), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  # Diagonal threshold lines (the "diagonal volcano" feature)
  geom_line(data = diag_right, aes(x = x, y = y),
            color = "#B22222", linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(data = diag_left,  aes(x = x, y = y),
            color = "#1F4E79", linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "solid") +
  # Labels for top DEGs
  geom_text_repel(data = top_up,   aes(label = id),
                  color = "#B22222", size = 3.2, max.overlaps = 30,
                  box.padding = 0.3, segment.color = "grey50") +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_down, aes(label = id),
                  color = "#1F4E79", size = 3.2, max.overlaps = 30,
                  box.padding = 0.3, segment.color = "grey50") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(8)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-xmax_x * 1.05, xmax_x * 1.05),
                  ylim  = c(0, ymax_plot), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Diagonal Volcano Plot",
    subtitle = sprintf("|log2FC| > %.1f & p < %.2f  |  Up = %d, Down = %d, NS = %d",
                       fc_cut, p_cut,
                       sum(deg_clean$Regulation == "Up"),
                       sum(deg_clean$Regulation == "Down"),
                       sum(deg_clean$Regulation == "NS")),
    x = "log2(Fold Change)",
    y = expression(-log[10]~"(p-value)"))
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "none"
  )

ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", p, width = 9, height = 6.5, dpi = 200)
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.pdf", p, width = 9, height = 6.5)
cat("\nSaved: diagonal_volcano.png, diagonal_volcano.pdf\n")
ls -la diagonal_volcano.png diagonal_volcano.pdf 2>&1; echo "---data dir---"; ls -la data/ 2>&1 | head

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
})

set.seed(42)

# --- 1. Load differential analysis results ---
deg <- as.data.frame(read_excel("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet 1"))
cat("Loaded:", nrow(deg), "rows\n")

# Drop NA, keep positive p, dedup (smallest p per gene)
deg <- deg[!is.na(deg$pvalue) & !is.na(deg$log2FoldChange) & deg$pvalue > 0, ]
deg <- deg[order(deg$pvalue), ]
deg <- deg[!duplicated(deg$id), ]
cat("Clean rows:", nrow(deg), "\n")

# -log10(p); cap Inf
max_finite <- max(-log10(deg$pvalue[is.finite(-log10(deg$pvalue))]))
deg$neglogp <- -log10(deg$pvalue)
deg$neglogp[!is.finite(deg$neglogp)] <- max_finite

# --- 2. Thresholds ---
fc_cut <- 1.0
p_cut  <- 0.05
y_thr  <- -log10(p_cut)   # ~1.301
slope  <- 0.6
cat("y_thr:", round(y_thr, 3), "  slope:", slope, "\n")

# --- 3. Classification ---
deg$Regulation <- "NS"
deg$Regulation[deg$log2FoldChange >  fc_cut & deg$pvalue < p_cut] <- "Up"
deg$Regulation[deg$log2FoldChange < -fc_cut & deg$pvalue < p_cut] <- "Down"
cat("Counts:\n"); print(table(deg$Regulation))

# --- 4. Diagonal threshold lines ---
xmax_x <- max(abs(deg$log2FoldChange))
x_seq_r <- seq(fc_cut,  xmax_x * 1.05, length.out = 200)
x_seq_l <- seq(-xmax_x * 1.05, -fc_cut, length.out = 200)
diag_right <- data.frame(x = x_seq_r, y = y_thr + slope * (x_seq_r - fc_cut))
diag_left  <- data.frame(x = x_seq_l, y = y_thr + slope * (-x_seq_l - fc_cut))
ymax_plot <- max(c(deg$neglogp, diag_right$y, diag_left$y)) * 1.05

# --- 5. Top genes for labelling ---
top_up   <- head(deg[deg$Regulation == "Up", ], 10)
top_down <- head(deg[deg$Regulation == "Down", ], 10)
cat("Top 5 Up:\n");   print(top_up[1:5,   c("id","log2FoldChange","pvalue")])
cat("\nTop 5 Down:\n"); print(top_down[1:5, c("id","log2FoldChange","pvalue")])

# --- 6. Build diagonal volcano plot ---
ns_df   <- deg[deg$Regulation == "NS", ]
down_df <- deg[deg$Regulation == "Down", ]
up_df   <- deg[deg$Regulation == "Up", ]

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = ns_df,
             aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neglogp),
             color = "grey75", size = 1.1, alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_point(data = down_df,
             aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neglogp),
             color = "#3B7BB5", size = 1.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(data = up_df,
             aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neglogp),
             color = "#D6423A", size = 1.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = y_thr, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cut, fc_cut), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = diag_right, aes(x = x, y = y),
            color = "#B22222", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = diag_left,  aes(x = x, y = y),
            color = "#1F4E79", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_up,   aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neglogp, label = id),
                  color = "#B22222", size = 3.2, max.overlaps = 30,
                  box.padding = 0.3, segment.color = "grey50") +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_down, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neglogp, label = id),
                  color = "#1F4E79", size = 3.2, max.overlaps = 30,
                  box.padding = 0.3, segment.color = "grey50") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-xmax_x * 1.05, xmax_x * 1.05),
                  ylim  = c(0, ymax_plot), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Diagonal Volcano Plot",
    subtitle = sprintf("|log2FC| > %.1f & p < %.2f  |  Up = %d, Down = %d, NS = %d",
                       fc_cut, p_cut,
                       sum(deg$Regulation == "Up"),
                       sum(deg$Regulation == "Down"),
                       sum(deg$Regulation == "NS")),
    x = "log2 (Fold Change)",
    y = "-log10 (p-value)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "none"
  )

ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", p, width = 9, height = 6.5, dpi = 200)
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.pdf", p, width = 9, height = 6.5)

cat("\nFiles now:\n")
print(list.files(pattern = "diagonal_volcano"))
